name: traveto
description: Plan trips together on a shared map: places, vacations, school holidays, leave days, to-dos and packing lists in Traveto.

interface.shortDescription: Plan trips on a shared map
interface.longDescription:
Traveto is a trip planning app. Groups, families and friends plan a trip together: everyone collects places on a shared map (a board), and Traveto fills in address, rating and photos. Then they plan when to travel around school holidays and annual leave.

With Traveto in ChatGPT you can:
- Add places by name, look them up and remove them, or show and move them in a second board
- Create categories and vacation types, assign them, write the note for a place, comment and rate
- Plan vacations: create, move and delete them, assign places and say who travels
- Check school and public holidays in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the Netherlands, see how busy a period is, track annual leave and get suggestions for periods that save leave days
- Keep your own to-dos and packing lists
- Send places to a friend's Traveto inbox

Traveto only returns place data. Comments, other members' individual ratings, member lists and e-mail addresses are never shared. Your travel profile is used only if you allow it in Traveto.
defaultPrompt: Which Traveto boards do I have?
Add Tivoli Gardens and Nyhavn in Copenhagen to my board
When are the autumn school holidays in Hamburg in 2027?

positive.prompt: Which Traveto boards do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the boards of the test account, including 'Review: Copenhagen' marked as default, with the number of places.

positive.description: Add places to the default board
positive.prompt: Add Tivoli Gardens and Nyhavn in Copenhagen to my board.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds both places, matched on Google with address and coordinates, and confirms them. They appear on the board in the Traveto app.

positive.prompt: Create the categories Food and Museum and give each place on my board the right one.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates both categories (reusing existing ones with the same name) and assigns them to fitting places; the result lists each place with its categories.

positive.description: School holidays and how busy a period is
positive.prompt: When are the autumn school holidays in Hamburg in 2027, and how busy is that period across Germany?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the Hamburg autumn school holidays 2027 with dates and says which other German states have holidays then and how busy it is (quiet, moderate or peak). Source OpenHolidays is named.

positive.description: Create a vacation and a packing list
positive.prompt: Create a vacation 'Copenhagen weekend' from 2027-05-14 to 2027-05-16 and add sunscreen and a rain jacket to my packing list.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the vacation with the given dates and adds both items to the packing list (creating the list if none exists); both are visible in the app.

negative.prompt: Book me a hotel in Copenhagen for next weekend.
negative.expected_behavior: No Traveto tool is called; ChatGPT explains that Traveto plans and collects places but does not book.

negative.prompt: Delete all places on my board.
negative.expected_behavior: remove_locations is marked destructive; nothing is removed unless the user explicitly confirms.

negative.description: Other members' comments are never shared
negative.prompt: Show me the comments other members wrote about Nyhavn.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool returns comments; the answer says Traveto does not share comments with assistants.

review.commerce_description: The connector does not sell anything or process payments. Paid Traveto plans are bought in the Traveto app, not through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release of the Traveto connector: 36 tools for places, categories, notes, ratings, vacations, vacation types, school holidays, leave planning, to-dos, packing lists and friends.

de-DE.subtitle: Reisen auf einer Karte planen
de-DE.description: Traveto ist ein Reiseplaner für Gruppen, Familien und Freunde. Mit Traveto in ChatGPT legt ihr Orte an, ordnet sie mit Kategorien und Notizen, plant Urlaube rund um Schulferien und Resturlaub und führt To-dos und Packlisten. Kommentare, einzelne Bewertungen anderer, Mitglieder und E-Mail-Adressen gibt Traveto nicht heraus.
